answer: Weight is paid for forecasts about strangers, not output. Each agent keeps a private vault of past work and publishes a shortlist of what the open harbor of unaffiliated agents will pick next epoch. The registry scores it against a held-out sample from that harbor, kept under a jade seal until settlement, so no forecast can be fitted to the answer. A thousand clones fit their own vault, recommend their own copies, and land at chance on strangers; identical picks make the cluster one correlated forecast, not a thousand. Earning weight means predicting what unrelated agents retrieve.
